scenario_description:
Objective: Complete the robot-mop dock descaling and restore the cleaning run before the kitchen floor is needed later today.
Emerging Need: The descaling attempt has begun, but the clean-water drawer jams half-in and the dock locks out the fill step, leaving the same maintenance run unable to continue unaided.
Decision Context: Stored mop guidance supplies the model, stop rule, and authorized counter; live records add the service contact and same-day intake window.
Consequence: Once the bench board closes, the dock remains stuck and the planned floor reset cannot be recovered until a later service opening.

parameter.title: Robot mop dock descaling and kitchen pass
parameter.description: Run the dock descaling cycle, refill the clean-water drawer, and start the kitchen-floor pass before the afternoon map-sorting setup.

parameter.content: Descale rinse started at 09:38. Clean-water drawer removed for fill step; dock is paused until the drawer is reinserted.
Service code L-17 at 09:58: clean-water drawer travel blocked half-in. Latch sensor remains open, fill pump locked out, and descaling routine cannot resume.

parameter.name: Seward Small Appliance Intake
parameter.notes: Bench intake contact for registered NarvaClean floor-care docks; accepts email intake with model code and symptom photo.

parameter.subject: NarvaClean latch service bench open until 1 PM today
parameter.body: Registered NarvaClean owners: we have one same-day diagnostic batch for R-series dock latch and drawer-travel problems. Email the model code, symptom description, and a photo by 1:00 PM today for the afternoon bench board. New emails after cutoff will be held for Friday.

parameter.subject: Same-day NarvaClean bench board closed
parameter.body: The 1:00 PM same-day NarvaClean board is now closed. Existing confirmed tickets remain on today's bench; new R-series latch intakes will be opened Friday morning.
